concerns.text: FR-002 and Constitution Principle VI require computing the 'dominant eigenvalue' (entanglement score) PER SAMPLE to quantify structural complexity for individual data points. Task T022b explicitly calculates a GLOBAL dominant eigenvalue from the entire dataset's covariance matrix and broadcasts it to all rows. This architectural deviation means no task exists to compute the per-sample eigenvalue required by the spec, rendering the hypothesis untestable.

FR-002 requires the 'dimensional variance score' (including per-sample eigenvalue) for each sample. Task T025a imports the GLOBAL eigenvalue from T022b and broadcasts it, failing to include the missing per-sample eigenvalue feature. No task exists to calculate per-sample covariance/eigenvalues, leaving a critical feature gap for the predictive model.

FR-001 requires ingesting the Z-Reward dataset. Task T037 hard-codes the dataset ID 'z-reward/z-reward-v1' and mandates a RuntimeError if unavailable, contradicting the spec's Assumption that the dataset is available 'or a specified archive' and violating robustness. No task exists to handle the fallback to a specified archive or alternative verified source if the primary ID fails, risking pipeline failure if the specific ID is incorrect.

FR-003 requires the system to 'compute' the dimensional fidelity loss (MAE) as a defined metric. Task T024 focuses on filtering and writing the dataframe to 'cleaned_data.parquet' but does not explicitly define a task to calculate and output the MAE metric as a distinct, verifiable artifact (e.g., a summary statistic) before or alongside the data write, potentially obscuring the verification of the metric itself.

SC-002 requires a paired t-test or R² > 0.0 for null baseline comparison. Task T030c introduces a 'bootstrap-based comparison' fallback not mentioned in the spec. While potentially useful, this adds unverified complexity and scope creep. A task should be added or T030c refined to strictly adhere to the spec's defined validation methods (t-test or R² > 0.0) to ensure coverage of the success criteria without extraneous logic.
